name: Tabetha
summary: Tabetha is a reclusive, powerful human mage dwelling deep within Dustwallow Marsh at an isolated farmstead in the Quagmire. Far from the politics of Dalaran or Theramore, she instructs aspiring spellcasters and aids those seeking mastery over potent arcane and occult relics.

sections.title: Hermit of the Quagmire
sections.body: Hidden away in the sodden expanse of Dustwallow Marsh north of the Stonemaul Ruins, Tabetha lives in a secluded shack alongside her apprentices. Surrounding herself with alchemical vials and ancient tomes, she has deliberately chosen solitude over the academic hierarchies of the Eastern Kingdoms. Despite her remote location, her mastery of the arcane is renowned enough that spellcasters across Kalimdor brave beasts and mire alike to seek her guidance.

sections.title: A Neutral Mentor
sections.body: Tabetha stands notably apart from factional hostilities. While human by birth, she turns away neither Alliance nor Horde initiates who demonstrate the will to learn, providing tutelage to mages and assisting warlocks with dangerous bindings such as the Orb of Orahil. Her past connects her to figures like Menara Voidrender, revealing an extensive history with esoteric magic that transcends simple faction allegiance.

faq.answer: Tabetha lives in a secluded shack at Tabetha's Farm, situated deep within the Quagmire in western Dustwallow Marsh, just north of the Stonemaul Ruins.

faq.q: Is Tabetha hostile to Horde players?
faq.answer: No. Despite being human, Tabetha is neutral. She teaches apprentices and aids spellcasters of both the Horde and the Alliance without discrimination.

faq.q: Why do mages and warlocks seek her out?
faq.answer: Tabetha possesses rare knowledge regarding arcane rituals, magical foci, and binding rites. Mages consult her for craft mastery and power trials, while warlocks seek her expertise to cleanse or bind potent artifacts like the Orb of Orahil.

faq.q: What is her connection to Menara Voidrender?
faq.answer: Tabetha shares an established history with Menara Voidrender. While their paths have diverged, their mutual understanding of powerful relics and binding magic links them across their respective hermitages.

angles.text: Tabetha is an essential mentor for mid-level mages, testing your grasp of arcane rituals and sending you across dangerous lands like Uldaman to refine your craft.
Though she practices the arcane, Tabetha's deep understanding of magical relics makes her a critical guide when dealing with dangerous artifacts like the Infernal Orb and the Orb of Orahil.
